final: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM batting AS b JOIN player AS p ON b.player_id COLLATE BINARY = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.death_country), shares AS (SELECT death_country, row_count, 1.0 * row_count / SUM(row_count) OVER () AS share FROM country_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.death_country, s.row_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
